 ‘Spending your money again?’ Sam YG teases Alden Richards at Ferrari showroom 
 Alden Richards found himself at the receiving end of Sam YG's jokes after the two crossed paths at a Ferrari showroom, where the radio host teased the actor about spending his money on another luxury ride.
 October 23, 2026 • 
 3:46 PM 
 Share
 By Bilyonaryo staff 
 Alden Richards found himself at the receiving end of Sam YG’s jokes after the two crossed paths at a Ferrari showroom, where the radio host teased the actor about spending his money on another luxury ride.
 In a video posted on his Instagram Stories, Sam wasted no time poking fun at Alden.
 https://imgs.bilyonaryo.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/StorySaver.net-_samyg-Video-1792741233872.mp4 
 “It’s my boy, it’s my boy! Are you spending your money again, bro? You’re spending your money again,” he quipped.
 Sam then turned up the teasing, exclaiming, “Oh shit! He’s crying, he’s crying!”
 “Why you crying @aldenrichards02??” Sam wrote in the caption.
 Alden responded by covering his face with his hands, although a smirk gave away his amusement as Sam continued the banter.
 Whether the actor was actually eyeing a Ferrari remains unclear, as the video offered no confirmation of a planned purchase.
 Still, Sam’s jokes put Alden’s spending in the spotlight, with the actor known not only for his successful showbiz career but also for his business ventures.
 From box-office hits to television projects, Alden has built a career that extends beyond acting. —Bilyonaryo.com
